gate_reason: No demonstrated improvement in approved native implementer utility while value normalization and error propagation remain unadopted; no self-certified GO.
scope: Linux current filesystem namespace, regular files, two literal equality identity forms, filesystem all, no traversal; 21 selected fields.
source_note: The Open Group Issue 8 publisher pages returned HTTP 403 to the web reader. POSIX citations use the licensed POSIX.1-2017 reproduction, labeled separately from Linux behavior. No copied HTML/XSD prose is redistributed.

claims.subject: Object.filepath
claims.summary: Object keeps source selector spelling; native Item field is renamed. Alternative scalar equality forms are used without inferring other operators.

claims.subject: Object selector operators
claims.summary: Native five-string-operator crosswalk is documented. Prototype executes only scalar equals; references/arrays/regex are outside its profile.

claims.subject: Object.filename null
claims.summary: Resolved native selector notes preserve directory-object selection; empty string is a string operand, not null. Directory acquisition is outside the regular-file profile.

claims.subject: Profile
claims.summary: Absolute paths and no dot/repeated/trailing separators define a narrow prototype input profile, not new native grammar. filepath absolute-path meaning is explicit in OVAL; native resolved literal grammar is broader.

claims.subject: Suggested API recipe
claims.summary: Linux parent directory descriptor plus one-component fstatat(AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW); S_ISREG guard. This is an implementation suggestion, not approved SCAP-NG link policy.

claims.subject: Observation consistency
claims.summary: Parent descriptor reduces pathname races but does not prevent ancestor symlinks, enforce mount containment or make stat fields an atomic snapshot. No retry-to-success completeness guarantee.

claims.subject: Item statuses
claims.summary: OVAL permits optional diagnostic does-not-exist Items; native Item status excludes does_not_exist. Missing selected Items are omitted.

claims.subject: Collection statuses
claims.summary: Native serializes collection states with underscore tokens and requires diagnostics for error/incomplete. Source flags are not automatically native Test-outcome rules.

claims.subject: Typed field statuses
claims.summary: Native typed fields distinguish exists, does_not_exist, error and not_collected; non-existing/error/not-collected fields carry no value. No new field-error propagation policy is adopted.

claims.subject: ENOENT
claims.summary: Proposed collection does_not_exist with zero Items only under the controlled missing-leaf fixture assumptions; errno alone is not proof of global absence.

claims.subject: EACCES
claims.summary: Proposed collection error, population_complete false and diagnostic, not a successful empty collection.

claims.subject: ENOTDIR/ELOOP/EOVERFLOW/EIO and other errno
claims.summary: Retain lookup failure and diagnostic; do not erase it as absence or use an uninitialized stat buffer.

claims.subject: Traversal and filesystem boundaries
claims.summary: Frozen depth/token syntax and imported defined-to-same names are known; full_path/directory semantic-rule names, symlink following, same/local classification and mount boundaries remain unresolved. Profile uses explicit filesystem all and no traversal.

claims.subject: Size and ACL
claims.summary: Source size units and ACL unsupported convention exist; they are not implemented by this selected 21-field prototype. Omission does not mean zero/false or absent field, and does not establish full-capability completeness.

decisions.D-scope: Profile subset is not the complete native selector/normalization/traversal contract.
decisions.D-type: Native file-type string vocabulary, including regular, is not enumerated by the frozen mapping.
decisions.D-time: Native epoch, units, precision and negative-time normalization require adoption.
decisions.D-permissions: Raw mode-bit versus effective-access/privilege meaning needs an explicit native contract.
decisions.D-errors: Errno-to-collection/Item/field mapping and native Test propagation need adoption; no outcome rule is inferred from schema acceptance.
decisions.D-links: Target/link and ancestor-link, traversal, mount and race policies remain unresolved.
decisions.D-acl: ACL acquisition and unsupported-status mapping remain unresolved and excluded.
